[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikandijapan/gremory-tale-of-the-god-slayer-adult-vn-bullethell?ref=2y1gw2]The campaign is now live[/url][/b], with a minimum funding goal of $4,650 USD, several stretch goals, and even social media goals that will unlock great bonus content.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33076600/283a5c831464968a9ea9cbccb89acd2014513f1f.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Pledge $20 or more, get the digital version of the limited artwork.
[*] Pledge $75 or more, get the digital AND physical version of the limited artwork.

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikandijapan/gremory-tale-of-the-god-slayer-adult-vn-bullethell?ref=2y1gw2]Visit the Gremory campaign here![/url][/h1]

Thank you for the support!
